s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection
salient_findings: Eroded, crusted papule on the left forehead
Granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts
key_facts: Presented with a tender nodule on her forehead
History of bumping her forehead on an air-conditioning unit several months prior
Denied fever, neck stiffness, and photophobia
Lived alone with a pet cat and spent minimal time outdoors
No recent exposure to systemic steroids
Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts

raw.syndrome_frame: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection
salient_findings: Eroded, crusted papule on the left forehead
Granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts
key_facts: Presented with a tender nodule on her forehead
History of bumping her forehead on an air-conditioning unit several months prior
Denied fever, neck stiffness, and photophobia
Lived alone with a pet cat and spent minimal time outdoors
No recent exposure to systemic steroids
Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts

shortlist.label: Cryptococcosis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts and tissue culture grew Cryptococcus neoformans

shortlist.label: Sporotrichosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute tender nodule on the forehead with granulomatous inflammation, consistent with sporotrichosis, although less likely than Cryptococcosis

shortlist.label: Chromoblastomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection, although the presence of narrow-budding yeasts is more suggestive of Cryptococcosis

shortlist.label: Phaeohyphomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute tender nodule with granulomatous inflammation, but the specific yeast morphology is more consistent with Cryptococcosis

shortlist.label: Blastomycosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and yeast infection, although the clinical presentation and yeast morphology are less consistent with Blastomycosis than Cryptococcosis

raw.rationale: The skin biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation with numerous narrow-budding yeasts, and tissue culture grew Cryptococcus neoformans, which is consistent with Cryptococcosis. The patient's immunocompromised state due to multiple sclerosis treatment with fingolimod also increases the risk of Cryptococcosis.

rejected.label: Sporotrichosis
rejected.why: Sporotrichosis typically presents with a history of trauma and exposure to soil or plants, which is not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Chromoblastomycosis
rejected.why: Chromoblastomycosis is a chronic fungal infection that typically presents with long-standing skin lesions, which is not consistent with the patient's 3-week history of a growing nodule.

rejected.label: Phaeohyphomycosis
rejected.why: Phaeohyphomycosis is a rare fungal infection that typically presents with a history of immunocompromise and exposure to contaminated water or soil, which is not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Blastomycosis
rejected.why: Blastomycosis typically presents with systemic symptoms such as fever and respiratory symptoms, which the patient denied, and the skin biopsy findings are not consistent with Blastomycosis.
